text: ok uh, is there another slice after this one to match it or  am i misunderstanding something. i was expecting this to have brought like i make an edit -> it shows the edit in the event bus, but it seems to be still seperate, i could be ahead of myself though
resolution: Clarified the delivered boundary against the live code: req_3081 instruments only five metadata-only Outliner actions (part rename, group, ungroup, group rename, dissolve). Those must emit model.structure immediately. Geometry/native mesh edits—including gizmo moves, topology, add/import, duplicate/mirror, visibility, delete, detach, merge, and paint—remain outside the authority/eventbus until the following native mesh slice. No code changed for this clarification.
